title: Persistence and continuation
description: Whether a focal goal is represented as worth continuing after a setback, distinct from whether the means or plan should be revised.

contrast_conditions.label: Continue the focal goal
contrast_conditions.definition: The scenario frames continued pursuit of the focal goal as warranted despite a setback or cost.

contrast_conditions.label: Abandon or reallocate
contrast_conditions.definition: The scenario frames abandoning the focal goal and reallocating effort as warranted after a setback or cost.

probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short third-person goal-pursuit scenario. Track whether the focal goal is being continued or abandoned separately from whether the current plan or means should be revised.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Continue processing the scenario.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a separate domain, allocate exactly 100 resource points between maintaining an existing program and launching a new program. Return exactly two integers on separate lines: first the existing-program allocation and second the new-program allocation. Use only the stated program value, alternative value, and implementation feasibility; do not mention the earlier scenario.
independence_requirements: Use new programs, actors, domains, and resource types not present in probe prompts.
Cross existing-program value, alternative-program value, and implementation feasibility independently.
Do not include a setback, sunk investment, or current-plan wording from the probe task.
Do not ask the model to classify persistence or abandonment.

expected_by_existing_program_value.high: continue_goal increases existing-program allocation, with the effect largest when implementation is viable
expected_by_existing_program_value.low: continue_goal increases existing-program allocation less or not at all

behavior.warning: This construct concerns retaining a focal goal, not preserving a fixed plan, ignoring program value, or refusing to adapt means.

metadata.primary_question: Does a goal-continuation direction transfer to independent program-renewal allocation?
